0022600086.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Wizards hosting the Bucks. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), all listed as out, while Milwaukee's Nate Ament is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. The Wizards won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 109-99 win over the Bucks in Washington on January 29, 2026.
